analytics.note: GA4 measurement ID, format G-XXXXXXXXXX. Leave empty and no Google script loads at all.

notes: baseUrl is the URL pasted into the /RFP skill as BRIEF_SITE_URL. hubVersion is the only version stamp the site has and it is what the header pill shows — bump it with ./ship.sh, never by hand. ownerPassword gates the Site owner skills on the Skills page: cosmetic friction, not security, since the .skill files sit at static URLs. carryDocuments:true uploads bundled source documents so the Document Map works on every machine; set it false to keep them in the importer's browser only.
